text:
lina: Quick UX copy review: the billing settings flow lets org admins switch the display currency for invoices. The confirmation dialog currently says \"Switch currency to EUR?\" and a single \"Confirm\" CTA. Finance asked for clearer copy about historical invoices and rounding.
rob: Good catch. We should avoid implying any retroactive conversion. Maybe: \"Change billing currency to EUR for future invoices only.\" with a smaller paragraph under it.
emily: Accessibility and tone nits: avoid ALL CAPS, use sentence case. Make the caution copy succinct and active voice. Also ensure the dialog has a descriptive heading (h3) and that the warning text is linked to the invoices FAQ.
lina: Draft copy suggestion:
```
Heading: Change billing currency
Body: Switching your billing currency will affect how future invoices are displayed. Past invoices will remain in their original currency and are not converted.
Caveat (small): Prices and totals on future invoices may be rounded. For details, see our invoices FAQ.
Primary CTA: Change currency
Secondary CTA: Cancel
```
rob: Tiny wording tweak: replace \"affect how future invoices are displayed\" with \"change the currency used on future invoices\" 12 clearer. Also prefer \"View invoices FAQ\" as the link text.
emily: Accessibility checklist from design-bot: ensure the dialog has role=\"dialog\", focus trap, keyboard focus on primary CTA, and that the link has an accessible name. Provide aria-live updates if the currency table updates in the background.
design-bot: Dialog accessibility reminders: role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby points to the heading id, ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for all actionable text, and include an accessible description id referenced by aria-describedby. Keep the dialog under 400 characters for screen reader brevity.
lina: Also add a tiny snippet under the heading that displays the selected currency and an example amount, e.g., \"Example: 49.99 EUR\" so users can quickly see the format. Use non-bold monospace for amounts? Not necessary.
rob: For localization: avoid embedding currency symbols in copy; use a localized amount format component. The microcopy should read: \"Example: 49.99 EUR\" not \"$49.99\".
emily: Can we add one-line audit info in the dialog footer: \"Change recorded in audit log\" with a small info icon and tooltip that reads \"Admins can see changes in Billing > History\"? Keep audit text unobtrusive.
lina: Great. I'll update the Figma mocks with the new copy and the small example amount. Emily, can you run the accessibility checklist on the prototype after I post it?
emily: Yep, will run it and flag any focus/order issues. :white_check_mark:
rob: I'll update the translation keys: `billing.currency.change.heading`, `billing.currency.change.body`, `billing.currency.change.caveat`, `billing.currency.change.cta_confirm`, `billing.currency.change.cta_cancel`, `billing.currency.change.example`, `billing.currency.change.audit_note`. Use placeholders for currency and example amount.
lina: Thanks all. Posting updated mock in ~30m. :coffee:
